captures.name: dialog
captures.title: Open the new-session dialog
captures.body: Everything a run needs is in this one dialog: the machine, the folder, the prompt and the profile.

captures.name: where
captures.title: Pick where it runs
captures.body: Choose the machine, then the folder. That folder is the agent’s whole world — it reads and edits what is inside it and nothing else, so point it at the project you actually mean. Set them now.

captures.name: filled
captures.title: Say what you want done
captures.body: This is the agent’s brief, and it is the whole instruction — it will not ask what you meant before it starts. Be as specific as you would be with a new colleague.

captures.name: profiles
captures.title: The profile decides how it thinks
captures.body: A profile bundles four things: the harness, the model, how hard it reasons, and how much it may do without asking. Pick one rather than setting all four every launch — keep a cheap one for throwaway work and a careful one for the rest.

captures.name: saved
captures.title: Draft it rather than launch it
captures.body: Launch would start the agent now — it would begin reading and editing the folder you chose. Draft, beside it, saves all of this and runs nothing. Press Draft: you can launch it whenever you like.

captures.name: draft
captures.title: Where the draft went
captures.body: Drafts have their own group in the list, switched off until you ask for it — behind this button, with all the other groups. Your run waits there with its machine, folder, profile and prompt intact, and nothing executes until you launch it.
